**Finding: T4C — compliant (at fallback).**

- **Customer right:** § 12.3 (p0590) lets AbbVie terminate "for any or no reason," in whole or country-by-country, on **90 days'** written notice — within the fallback 60–90 day band.
- **Early-termination fee:** none. The consequence provisions (§§ 12.6.1, 12.7, 12.8, 12.10.2) deal only with reversion, inventory sell-off and accrued/surviving payments, so the three-month fee cap is met a fortiori.
- **Vendor side:** Harpoon may terminate only for uncured material breach (§ 12.2.1/12.2.2) or insolvency (§ 12.4) — no convenience right at all, which exceeds the fallback and matches the preferred "no Vendor mid-term convenience" position.
- **Short of preferred only in minor respects** (90 rather than 30 days' notice; no express pro-rata refund, consistent with the non-refundable upfront/milestone economics in Article 6) — noted, not redlined.

No redline proposed.
